topography.project_purpose: TokenWorks provides automated NFT strategies, enabling users to deploy and manage yield-generating or utility-maximizing strategies for NFTs, starting with CryptoPunks.
topography.relationship_narrative: The NFTStrategyFactory deploys and registers strategy contracts like PunkStrategy and PunkStrategyPatch, which interact with the external CryptoPunksMarket contract to manage CryptoPunks NFTs.
